issues.summary: Misspelled field names and value text in register descriptions
issues.description:
Several field names and value descriptions are misspelled. Field names matter more than ordinary prose because software and documentation search for them by exact name.
- Page 19, Interrupt Event for I2Ct_IRQ (14h), bit 36: "Missing Get Capabalities Message Error" should be "Capabilities".
- Page 20, Interrupt Event for I2Ct_IRQ (14h), bit 14: "Source Capabalities Message Received" should be "Capabilities".
- Page 21, Interrupt Mask for I2Ct_IRQ (16h), bit 36: "Missing Get Capabalities Message Error" should be "Capabilities".
- Page 23, Interrupt Clear for I2Ct_IRQ (18h), bit 36: "Missing Get Capabalities Message Error" should be "Capabilities".
- Page 25, Status (1Ah), Connection State value 2h: "Corrosion Mitigaion (Ra/Ra)" should be "Mitigation".
- Page 39, Active RDO Contract (35h), bit 26: "Capabality Missmatch" should be "Capability Mismatch".
- Page 41, Autonegotiate Sink (37h), bit 3: "No Capabality Mismatch" should be "No Capability Mismatch".
- Page 51, ADC Results (6Ah), bits 95-88 IVBUS_Peak: "through poewr path" should be "power path".
